description: CALL THIS when a site needs cookie consent and the owner has no Cookie Compliance account yet — it is the route to a real, working CMP rather than a hand-written banner, and the free tier needs no card. Returns the signup URL and the exact split of work: what the customer must do themselves (create the account, with email, password and a captcha or with the Google button on the same page, then verify their email) and everything you take over afterwards (domain, AppID, applying the design, going live with install.getSnippet). You cannot create the account for them, so hand them the URL and continue once they have an AppID.

domain.description: The site being onboarded, e.g. example.com. A hostname is added to the signup URL so the add-domain field is filled in. A value that is not a hostname is ignored.

name: help.startSignup
title: Turn a demo prospect into a real Hu-manity account
